scope: Exact 19 pinned Millennium PNG source assets only. No gzip logs, runtime packages, source archive, EXE/DLL, installer or website changes.
checks: Exact fixed 19-path allowlist with byte/SHA and pinned source revision cross-checks against two provenance records
Original license SHA and module notices verified before input acquisition/write
All 20 downloads (license +19 PNG) verified in memory before any destination write
Existing file conflicts and symlink ancestors rejected; repeated import does not refetch or rewrite
Explicit staged PNG additions and exact Git blob hashes; extra files, modifications and changed staged bytes rejected
Remote tip checked before writes, before commit and before non-force push
Remote races independently tested after prefetch, after staging and after commit; no network push executed
Workflow restricted to fixed repository main branch, exact event SHA and pinned checkout action; narrow workflow push path prevents self-trigger
Git credential header exists only in final push environment, never source or command URL

resolved_issue.description: Pinned checkout action uses HTTPS origin without .git, while initial importer only accepted .git form
resolved_issue.status: Fixed in reviewed source: accepts exactly the two canonical HTTPS origins; foreign repository/host/credential URL rejected by regression tests

upstream_fetch_scope: Only read pinned checkout source to verify origin format. Importer fetches mocked in this independent QA; parent separately verifies real pinned artwork downloads.
remaining_limitations: This review does not assert the actual GitHub Actions run or authenticated push succeeded.
It does not clear full-runtime redistribution or test Windows game execution.
